nom: COSRX The AHA 2 BHA 2 Blemish Treatment Serum

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation, burning, or excess dryness even with regular use, though one reviewer describes her skin turning red and angry after application and limits use to once a week.
segments.mature: A couple of reviewers in their 50s and older report the treatment cleared stubborn clogged pores and reduced long-standing or adult acne.
segments.combination: One reviewer with both dry and oily areas reports the treatment worked well on breakouts across both zones.

concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report blackheads, whiteheads, and hormonal or cystic acne visibly reduced within one to several days of spot treatment, though a few describe slower results, one cystic pimple that did not respond, or occasional breakouts when the product was applied beyond the target area.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report the treatment calms redness and swelling around blemishes overnight, though one reviewer with sensitive skin found it left her skin red and irritated.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe the treatment as drying when used all over the face or too frequently, while others, including some with sensitive skin, report it did not dry out their skin at all.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer noticed feeling less oily throughout the day with continued use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with a sensitive skin barrier found the treatment gentle enough to use without problems.

aspects.libelle: Cotton balls are oversaturated, often wasted on small spots
Tweezers feel flimsy, cotton balls easily dropped
Hygienic, mess-free application without touching the face
Lid does not seal well, can leak in transit

extraits.texte: I have been using this for the past two weeks on any emerging pimples as well as on my nose and chin where blackheads tend to form, since yes, there is quite a lot of product on each cotton ball. I have sensitive skin and this did not irritate me at all. Emerging pimples seemed to stay small and go away a bit faster than normal. I did not notice a big difference in regard to the blackheads. The tongs were a nice way to pick up the cotton balls but I ended up using my fingers to hold and apply the product. I can't decide if the cotton balls are a nice convenient option, or if it would be easier to tell this as a toner and let folks choose their method of application. Regardless, it's a nice product and I'm happy to continue using it

Using for blemishes with adult cystic acne I was amazed at how quickly this helped reduce redness and with reduction in size. I have noticed a bit less of sebum over my nose and less blackheads but I cycle this with other skincare any only use 2-3 times a week (I have sensitive skin). Only con is so much serum is in one cotton boll i feel it a waste and putting it back into container defeats the purpose of a hygienic way to put on this produc.my. Overall I will purchase again and I recommend it for spot treatment of acne and reducing sebum/blackheads!

extraits.titre: Price is right if you want to give this a try
extraits.texte: I've only used this for a week but already see some results where bumps are less apparent and I haven't broken out. The individual swabs are a great size for spot treatment, but they are soaked with too much essence. I squeeze out the excess and will decant to prolong usage. My skin is sensitive so if i use this, I skip my other products for acne. I still get redness so I use it at night. I hope with longer use, this product will improve my rough cheeks.
I have dry and oily skin. This product works like a dream and absolutely helps to clear up and prevent both big and little bumps. I wish I would have found it sooner!!!

extraits.titre: Love it, but my skin dreads it
extraits.texte: Super effective, does exactly what it's supposed to do. Well worth it. Just note if you have sensitive skin this product is hard on it. Right after using it, my skin is pretty red and angry. I have to use more moisturizer than usual to prevent getting dry flaky skin the following day. I also skip all other products at nighttime in order to prevent additional irritation. I can also only tolerate it 1x/week. I tried 2x/week but it was too much. Could be my use of adapaline 6x/week but im pretty sure it's because my skin is just sensitive.

I have always suffered from sensitive, acne-prone skin. Naturally, with temperatures rising I have been worried about clogged pores and this treatment has greatly helped! I've seen reduction (and in some cases, complete removal) of clogged pores, red spots, whiteheads, and general irritation. I was a bit concerned about my skin becoming dry from usage, but I always follow with a moisturizer and sunscreen and have nev er had any problems with flaking or extreme reactions. I love this product and it really is a life saver for when youre in a pinch!

This is a blemish treatment that I know I'll be using whenever necessary. It's so easy to use and has excellent results. I have found that using the treatment has really helped reduce my blemishes and cleared my skin quickly. As someone 50+, I've had acne all of my life. I'm glad I've found COSRX and my family has been noticing my clearer skin. Great product!
